It covers AI-Designed Ultra-Strong Alloys — Materials discovered computationally and validated experimentally for demanding applications.

Materials are the quiet foundation of every other technology on this list. Computational discovery now proposes candidates faster than labs can test them; metamaterials engineer properties from geometry; self-healing and shape-changing materials add function.
